description.en: 15 art-history styles, one cat — every frame drawn by code on a canvas.
description.zh: 15 种艺术史风格，一只猫，每一帧都是代码在画布上画出来的。

description.en: Narrated, with motion landing on the words: every cue is anchored to a word in the voice track.
description.zh: 带配音的解说片，动作踩在词上：每个节点都锚定在配音里的某个词。

description.en: Title, a big number and an end card. The smallest project that follows the whole contract.
description.zh: 标题、一个大数字、一张片尾卡。遵守全部约定的最小工程，从这里开始做任何东西。

description.en: Economist-style data chart: layout, axes, the data grows, then one annotation. Bars, line or K-line from a JSON series.
description.zh: 经济学人风格的数据图：先版式，再坐标轴，数据长出来，最后一处标注。柱状、折线或 K 线，数据就是一段 JSON。

description.en: Black board, one idea at a time: a title is written, an equation turns into the next, a curve morphs, one point gets boxed.
description.zh: 黑板，一次只讲一个概念：写出标题，公式变成下一个公式，曲线变形，最后圈出一个点。

description.en: Name plate, count-up numbers, keyword captions and a chapter card over your own talking-head video, each landing on a spoken word.
description.zh: 给你自己的口播视频加名牌、数字卡、关键词花字和章节卡，每一样都踩在说出的那个词上。

description.en: Dark glowing backdrop, one thing per screen: a title floats out of blur, glass cards spring in, a screenshot gets a highlight box, a big number counts up.
description.zh: 深色发光背景，一屏只讲一件事：标题从模糊里浮出，玻璃卡片弹入，截图上出现高亮框，大数字滚动上涨。
